intuition: Each magazine character can be used once, so the magazine must contain every ransom-note character at least as often.

brute_force.approach: For each note character, search for and remove one matching magazine character.

optimal.approach: Count magazine characters and decrement the required count for each note character.

edge_cases: An empty ransom note can always be constructed.
Repeated note letters require repeated magazine letters.
The note cannot use any character more often than the magazine provides.
